preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(char in input for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output must be present in the input.
All characters in the output must appear more than once in the input.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join([char for char in input if input.count(char) > 1])
postconditions.description: The output is constructed by including only characters from the input that appear more than once.
